description: MCP server exposing LS증권 OpenAPI (REST) as tools. Read-only Korean and US/overseas stock market data and analysis via natural language.
releaseNotes: v1.6.2 — KR year charts work. ls_get_chart period_type="year" returned 0 candles in every earlier build, because LS's t8410 answers gubun=5 with '해당자료가 없습니다' and no rows. Year frames now come from t8451 ((통합) 주식차트) pinned to exchgubun=K, so they share the KRX market of the t8410 day/week/month frames. The 1.6.1 adjusted parameter (수정주가) applies; multi-timeframe and ls_reframe_chart / ls_add_indicator follow-ups work on year frames. Year frame tr_cd now reads t8451. Surface unchanged (50 standard / 53 all). Lockstep with RedoxNet.LsOpenApi.Core 1.6.2. See https://github.com/redoxnet/mcp-lsopenapi/blob/main/RELEASENOTES.Mcp.md.
